description:
About the job

This is a confidential search on behalf of a fast-growing, VC-backed technology company serving multi-site enterprises.




To protect confidentiality at this stage, we're not sharing further details about the business — the company's name and context will be shared with candidates who advance in the process.




Location: Mexico.
Work Setup: 100% remote.




What This Role Is About

You'll build and run this company's inbound marketing engine — designing multi-channel campaigns, owning HubSpot automation and lead scoring, and turning brand awareness into pipeline across the U.S. and LATAM. We're looking for someone with the urgency to launch fast, the curiosity to test new channels and AI tools, and the storytelling chops to make campaigns land — equally comfortable setting the strategy and running it day-to-day with minimal oversight.




What You'll Do

Design, launch, and manage integrated inbound campaigns tied to brand milestones, product launches, and industry events — building a campaign calendar that connects ads, email, social, and web into cohesive, multi-touch programs that drive MQL growth.
Create conversion-oriented content that powers those campaigns, including landing pages, case studies, webinars, ROI tools, emails, blog posts, and infographics — adapting messaging and language for the U.S. and LATAM markets.
Build and optimize HubSpot workflows, segmentation, and lead scoring to automate nurture across email, content, and social, partnering with Sales on closed-loop reporting tied directly to pipeline and revenue.
Launch, monitor, and optimize LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads, and own SEO strategy (keyword research, on-page optimization, performance monitoring), using A/B testing to continuously improve CTR, CPL, and conversion rates.
Own event and conference activation end-to-end — from pre-event content and lead-capture strategy to post-event nurture flows — maximizing ROI from the company's presence at industry events.
Track campaign ROI and funnel performance (Inquiry → MQL → SQL), deliver reporting dashboards in HubSpot, and use those insights — plus AI-powered marketing tools — to continuously refine targeting, content, and channel mix.




What We're Looking For

Must Have

3–5 years in B2B inbound/demand gen marketing.
Track record of campaigns that moved pipeline and revenue, not just activity.
Hands-on HubSpot: workflows, scoring, reporting.
Running LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and SEO.
Fluent with AI marketing tools — beyond basic prompting.
Bilingual English/Spanish, with U.S. market experience.
Comfortable owning strategy and execution with minimal oversight.




Nice to have, not required:

Energy or facilities management experience
Jira, ClickUp, Adobe Suite
Webinars, ABM, event marketing
SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics
Sales/RevOps collaboration




Benefits

Primarily remote work 

Reduced hours on Fridays 

Unlimited vacations 

Support for studies, training, and languages 

Referral program




If you're the kind of marketer who sees a new market and a blank campaign calendar and immediately wants to build the playbook — we'd love to meet you.

description:
About the job

Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar



Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina. Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven, creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal, reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones.

Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo

Nuestro equipo comercial trabaja bajo el modelo híbrido, combinando la flexibilidad del trabajo remoto con el intercambio presencial en nuestra oficina de Ciudad de México, 3 veces por semana.

Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío

El equipo de Retención es responsable de reducir la tasa de deserción y maximizar el valor de vida del cliente enfocado exclusivamente en el portafolio de pequeñas y medianas empresas. Esta es una posición de alto impacto y de nueva creación en México; serás responsable de frenar la principal fuga de revenue de la operación, construyendo los cimientos de la retención a nivel local. Buscamos personas con fuertes habilidades de negociación, empatía y resiliencia para liderar a un equipo de 5 personas.

Tus Responsabilidades


Dirigir, motivar y capacitar a un equipo de retención de 5 personas con perfil junior (mayormente nivel banda 2), brindando un acompañamiento cercano (micromanagement y coaching) para desarrollar sus habilidades de negociación desde cero.
Ejecutar estrategias de retención alineando los descuentos previos a la nueva lista de precios, utilizando palancas estratégicas para contener las bajas minimizando el impacto en el ARPA. 
Gestionar operativamente el flujo de casos de clientes que solicitan darse de baja, los cuales son escalados a través de Salesforce Chatter por los equipos de SMB, Cobranzas y Atención al Cliente. 
Monitorear métricas clave de éxito basadas en la cantidad de revenue (importe monetario) retenido y facturado, además del Churn Rate y el Customer Health Score. 
Conducir y supervisar llamadas consultivas de retención (con una duración promedio de 40 minutos), presentando a los clientes dashboards de productividad y métricas de rendimiento para justificar su inversión. 


Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)


Mínimo de 4 años de experiencia en ventas o retención, con al menos 2 años en roles de liderazgo de equipos.
Excelentes competencias de Negociación Avanzada para manejar conversaciones difíciles, apoyándose en el playbook de causísticas para cerrar acuerdos rentables. 
Sólido dominio de plataformas CRM, preferentemente Salesforce, para la gestión de casos operativos y análisis de datos. 
Resiliencia para mantener un trato profesional bajo presión y una alta capacidad de empatía para conectar con el cliente de forma genuina. 
Experiencia previa liderando equipos de customer care orientadas a la contención.

Diseñamos un proceso transparente, directo y enfocado en evaluar tu potencial técnico y comportamental, dándote la oportunidad de conocer a nuestros equipos y rutas de carrera:

Valoramos la diversidad y queremos que todas las personas se sientan bienvenidas aquí, independientemente de su edad, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, etnia, origen, discapacidad, religión o cualquier otra característica. ¡Todas nuestras vacantes están abiertas para todas las personas! Representada en más de 50 países y con productos vendidos en más de 170, el Grupo Ferrero encanta a numerosas generaciones en todo el planeta. ¿Cuál es el secreto de nuestro éxito mundial? 40,000 empleados especializados que celebran tanto el cuidado como la calidad para forjar un negocio, carreras profesionales y marcas de las que nos sentimos orgullosos. Únete a nosotros, podrías ser uno de ellos.

Acerca del Rol:

Este puesto tiene como objetivo brindar soporte en la gestión de marca y en la ejecución de estrategias de marketing y comunicación, participando activamente en la implementación de planes, campañas y activaciones en distintos canales de distribución.

Si tienes un perfil apasionado por el análisis de mercado, el Marketing y la generación de insights a través de la interpretación de datos ¡te estamos buscando!

Principales Responsabilidades:

Apoyarás en el desarrollo e implementación de planes de marketing y comunicación.

Darás seguimiento a materiales promocionales, activaciones y campañas en los diferentes canales de distribución.

Apoyarás en la recolección y organización de información de ventas, competencia, consumidor y tendencias.

Brindarás soporte en la comunicación con agencias creativas, de medios y promociones.

Monitorearás métricas básicas y apoyarás en la generación de contenidos.

Acerca de ti:


Estudiantes activos de Licenciatura, a partir de 5to. semestre (garantizar estatus activo de al menos un año y/o no tener más de 6 meses de egreso). 
Formación académica en Mercadotecnia, Comunicación o afines. 
Inglés nivel Avanzado Conversacional. 
Paquetería Office nivel Intermedio- Avanzado. 
Conocimiento en Herramientas de análisis de datos, nivel básico. 
Perfil proactivo, analítico (lógico-numérico), comunicación efectiva, organización, estructurado, atención al detalle, con enfoque a los resultados y capacidad para trabajar en equipo. 
Interés por aprender y desarrollarse en el área, en un entorno dinámico: desde la parte analítica, interpretación de data y generación de insights.


Nuestros Beneficios y ventajas:

Carreras con cuidado integrado: descubre nuestros beneficios aquí.

Acerca de Ferrero:

Ferrero comenzó su trayectoria en la pequeña ciudad de Alba en Piamonte, Italia, en 1946. Hoy en día, es una de las empresas de alimentos dulces envasados más grandes del mundo, con muchas marcas icónicas que se venden en todo el mundo. Descubre más sobre Ferrero en ferrero.com.

¿Cómo ser exitoso en el rol y en Ferrero?

Consumidores, calidad y servicio son la clave de todo cuanto hacemos. Así pues, para cosechar el éxito en Ferrero, deberás orientarte al consumidor y al producto tanto como nosotros: dedicarte a lograr buenos resultados para los clientes en todo el mundo.

DE&I en Ferrero:

Ferrero se compromete a construir una cultura diversa e inclusiva donde todos los empleados se sientan bienvenidos, valorados y tengan las mismas oportunidades. Creemos que todos nuestros empleados tienen el mismo talento, cada uno a su manera. Al fomentar la curiosidad y las habilidades naturales de nuestros empleados, les proporcionamos, generación tras generación, los medios para alcanzar el éxito personal y profesional, permitiéndoles forjar su trayectoria en Ferrero. La diversidad de nuestros talentos es lo que hace que nuestro entorno laboral sea multicultural, innovador y altamente gratificante. Descubre más aquí.

title: Digital Creative Producer
skills: 80% Social First & Digital: Eres un(a) maestro(a) del ritmo y la retención. Entiendes nativamente el lenguaje de TikTok, Reels y Shorts. Sabes qué engancha en los primeros 3 segundos, dominas las tendencias audiovisuales y entiendes la velocidad cultural de internet.
20% Tradicional & Craft (Complemento): Ejecución impecable, color grading, diseño sonoro y acabados premium para formatos Hero, TVC y campañas principales.

Impacto Total (Desde el Brief hasta el Set): Tu trabajo no empieza cuando te entregan un disco duro. Te involucras con el equipo creativo desde que llega el brief para viabilizar ideas. Además, acudes a las producciones y llamados, porque tu visión técnica de postproducción impacta y dirige al 100% la manera en la que el equipo físico tiene que grabar (planos, transiciones, recursos visuales).

Storytelling & Craft Visual: No eres un "toma-pedidos" que solo une clips. Eres un creador. Viabilizas y elevas la idea creativa aportando en narrativa, ritmo, comedia, transiciones y estructura visual.

Dueño(a) del Pipeline de Post: Control absoluto del flujo de trabajo (ingesta, offline, online, motion graphics, corrección de color y mezcla de audio). Optimizas los procesos para evitar cuellos de botella y "renders" eternos.

Criterio Técnico Profundo: Aunque tu rol es de liderazgo, tienes el background técnico (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci, herramientas de IA) para revisar maquetas, corregir detalles milimétricos y guiar a tu equipo.

KPIs Claros: Tu éxito se medirá en tiempos de entrega impecables (speed sin sacrificar calidad), reducción de peloteos/cambios con cliente, innovación en formatos y el crecimiento técnico del talento a tu cargo.
Líder de la Isla: Eres el líder directo de nuestro escuadrón de Editores, Animadores, Motion Graphers, Artistas 3D y Postproductores. Los inspiras, los guías y elevas su nivel técnico.

Tus Aliados Estratégicos: Trabajarás codo a codo con nuestro Director de Producción física (para asegurar que el set sirva a la post), con Directores Creativos y de Arte (para proteger la estética de la idea), y con Project Managers (para alinear entregas).

No Ego & Resolución: Cero fricciones territoriales. Buscamos a alguien que bajo presión no se congele, que proponga soluciones en el set o en la isla cuando el material tiene retos, y que fluya haciendo equipo.

About the job

Digital Creative Producer (Post-Production Lead)

En HASH convertimos publicidad en entretenimiento que la gente decide ver (Ad Entertainment). Hemos dividido nuestra área de Producción para darle a cada fase el peso que merece. Mientras nuestro equipo de Producción física controla la logística, buscamos a un(a) Digital Creative Producer que domine la magia que ocurre después del corte: la Postproducción.




El Reto (Tu enfoque)

80% Social First & Digital: Eres un(a) maestro(a) del ritmo y la retención. Entiendes nativamente el lenguaje de TikTok, Reels y Shorts. Sabes qué engancha en los primeros 3 segundos, dominas las tendencias audiovisuales y entiendes la velocidad cultural de internet.
20% Tradicional & Craft (Complemento): Ejecución impecable, color grading, diseño sonoro y acabados premium para formatos Hero, TVC y campañas principales.




Operación y Ejecución Técnica (Hard Skills)

Impacto Total (Desde el Brief hasta el Set): Tu trabajo no empieza cuando te entregan un disco duro. Te involucras con el equipo creativo desde que llega el brief para viabilizar ideas. Además, acudes a las producciones y llamados, porque tu visión técnica de postproducción impacta y dirige al 100% la manera en la que el equipo físico tiene que grabar (planos, transiciones, recursos visuales).
Storytelling & Craft Visual: No eres un "toma-pedidos" que solo une clips. Eres un creador. Viabilizas y elevas la idea creativa aportando en narrativa, ritmo, comedia, transiciones y estructura visual.
Dueño(a) del Pipeline de Post: Control absoluto del flujo de trabajo (ingesta, offline, online, motion graphics, corrección de color y mezcla de audio). Optimizas los procesos para evitar cuellos de botella y "renders" eternos.
Criterio Técnico Profundo: Aunque tu rol es de liderazgo, tienes el background técnico (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci, herramientas de IA) para revisar maquetas, corregir detalles milimétricos y guiar a tu equipo.
KPIs Claros: Tu éxito se medirá en tiempos de entrega impecables (speed sin sacrificar calidad), reducción de peloteos/cambios con cliente, innovación en formatos y el crecimiento técnico del talento a tu cargo.




Liderazgo y Coordinación In-House

Líder de la Isla: Eres el líder directo de nuestro escuadrón de Editores, Animadores, Motion Graphers, Artistas 3D y Postproductores. Los inspiras, los guías y elevas su nivel técnico.
Tus Aliados Estratégicos: Trabajarás codo a codo con nuestro Director de Producción física (para asegurar que el set sirva a la post), con Directores Creativos y de Arte (para proteger la estética de la idea), y con Project Managers (para alinear entregas).




ADN y Skills HASH

No Ego & Resolución: Cero fricciones territoriales. Buscamos a alguien que bajo presión no se congele, que proponga soluciones en el set o en la isla cuando el material tiene retos, y que fluya haciendo equipo.

description:
About the job

As a Solutions Engineer at Speechmatics, you’ll play a key role in helping customers successfully evaluate and adopt our industry-leading speech technology. You’ll partner closely with Sales to guide customers through the entire technical journey, from discovery and solution design to proof-of-concept delivery and technical validation.

This is a hands-on role: you’ll build demos, write code, deploy environments, and solve real customer problems.

You’ll also take ownership of selected accounts, helping scale the team’s impact while gaining exposure to global customers across multiple industries. We’ll support you with structured onboarding and training so you can quickly become confident with our technology and customers.

What You’ll Be Doing


Partnering with Sales to lead the technical pre-sales process from discovery to close 
Understanding customer requirements (security, scale, integrations, accuracy, workflows) and designing practical solutions 
Building and delivering technical demos, prototypes, and Proofs of Concept (PoCs) 
Deploying and configuring environments in cloud or on-prem setups for customer evaluations 
Writing scripts or lightweight integrations (Python or JavaScript) to support demos and customer testing 
Troubleshooting customer challenges and guiding them toward successful outcomes 
Delivering engaging technical presentations to customers, partners, and events 
Supporting conferences and showcases globally, including international travel, to deliver compelling technical demonstrations 
Sharing knowledge internally and helping Sales stay up to date as our platform evolves 


Who We’re Looking For


Previous experience working in a customer-facing technical role (Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Technical Consulting, or similar) 
Hands-on programming ability - ideally Python/JavaScript 
Comfortable working with APIs (REST and WebSocket), integrations, and technical troubleshooting 
Experience deploying or configuring software in cloud, Linux, containers, or networked environments 
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate customer needs into workable solutions 
Confident communicator who enjoys working directly with customers 
Self-motivated, curious, and eager to learn new technologies quickly 
Collaborative mindset and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously 


We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel you match all of the requirements exactly. The list of requirements is intended to show the kinds of experience and qualities we’re looking for, but it is not exhaustive. If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.

Who We Are

Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.

Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.

We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.

This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey…

What We Can Offer You

No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.

We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. But that’s not all. We’ve spoken to our teams to find out what they want. From Private Medical, and Dental for you and your family, through to global working opportunities, a generous holiday allowance and pension/401K matching, we want to make sure our employees and their families are looked after. Every employee will receive a working from home allowance for tech or home office equipment (on top of your choice of laptop and accessories of course). Our approach to parental leave is designed to support employees globally. While this varies by geo, we have support in place for parents (including adoption assistance and reproductive health services) to ensure they have the time and financial resources needed to care for their growing families.

At Speechmatics, our mission is simple: Understand Every Voice out there.

That's not just about our tech – it's the heart and soul of who we are. We welcome different experiences, viewpoints, and identities. For us, it’s not just the right thing to do; it’s our catalyst for sparking innovation and creativity. Our teams thrive in an environment that celebrates and supports everyone – no matter their gender, identity or expression, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief, marital status, national origin, veteran status, pregnancy, or maternity status.

But we don’t just open the door to diversity – we actively welcome it. Why? Because we believe every unique voice adds something special to our team, leading us to smarter solutions and a better workplace.

So, come as you are and join our Speechling community. We’re building a place where every voice not only gets heard but is also respected and valued.

For more information on us, please visit our website and follow Speechmatics on our social channels via Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment.

description:
About the job

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Merchant Care Analyst I is the foundational tier within our Merchant Care organisation, responsible for delivering efficient and timely responses to merchant inquiries. You will support tickets raised by merchants through any channel, instant messaging, email or web form, as well as requests from internal stakeholders, ensuring queries are addressed promptly and accurately within a specific product scope. The role combines resolving documented issues independently using our established knowledge base with recognising cases of higher complexity and escalating them with clear context to an Analyst II or Senior Analyst. Success in this role means strong communication, a solid understanding of payments, and a genuine sense of urgency in everything you pick up.

What You Will Be Doing


Acknowledge and administer tickets assigned via the ticketing system, remaining logged in and active during working hours.
Investigate and respond to merchant inquiries, as well as requests from internal stakeholders who engage Merchant Care for technical assistance.
Perform initial investigations and refer complex concerns to Analyst II, Senior Analysts, or Level 3 teams as appropriate, providing full context for a speedy resolution.
Resolve tickets using the existing knowledge base, identify documentation gaps, request new SOPs, and keep documentation up to date.
Maintain a solid understanding of our products, services, and policies to provide accurate information to merchants.
Comply with the quality assurance framework to minimise errors and deliver consistent care.
Categorise issues in the global queue and identify repetitive problems, escalating likely root causes to the wider team.
Report procedural problems and participate in feedback loops with our Product and Engineering teams.
Participate actively in training for new products and provide feedback on process gaps to project groups.


About You


2+ years of experience in technical support or operations roles, ideally within Fintech, Banking or Financial Services.
A degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Data or a related field, though equivalent professional experience in other disciplines will be considered.
A comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end payment flow
Strong problem-solving skills, breaking a merchant-reported symptom into checkable components and working through them methodically rather than by trial and error.
Proficient in one or more of the following: API troubleshooting with Postman, log and event analysis with Datadog, data querying with Looker, Snowflake or SQL, and secure environment access tooling such as Guacamole.
Comfortable following SOPs and troubleshooting guides accurately, and knowing which tool applies to which category of task.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to interpret complex technical issues in simple business terms for merchants and non-technical stakeholders.
Able to manage a live workload against SLA countdowns in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high service standards.
Proficiency in using customer service software (e.g. Zendesk, Salesforce) and CRM tools.
Proven ability to work independently as well as collaborate effectively across teams, seeking guidance proactively to ensure positive outcomes for merchants.
A genuine appetite for learning new concepts and technologies quickly, approaching all work with urgency, enthusiasm and a growth mindset.


Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

We're hiring a Product Manager for the ACME brand, a B2B SaaS platform for museums, cultural attractions, and non-profits across North America.

Beyond the ACME brand, you will need to understand what Peek and Connect&GO are building, so you can spot chances to extend a feature across brands instead of building it three times. Over time, there's room to take on more, including owning product areas across brands.

Peek is leaning into AI to solve problems, clear bottlenecks, and move faster, so we can deliver more value to the businesses that rely on us. We are looking for someone with product management experience who’s also excited about that shift and wants to help figure out how AI gets used here.

What You'll Do


Own features from discovery through launch. Write specs and PRDs engineering can act on without three rounds of clarifying questions, and think through edge cases before anything ships
Run discovery directly with customers: interviews, calls, feedback loops, not just tickets that land in your queue. Ask why before you write requirements, and be able to name the user problem behind every ticket
Manage a ticket backlog with accuracy. Nothing falls through the cracks

title: Analista de Customer Success
description:
About the job

En Achilles ayudamos a grandes empresas a gestionar y evaluar a sus proveedores a través de nuestra plataforma, fortaleciendo la transparencia, el cumplimiento y la gestión de riesgos en sus cadenas de suministro.




Buscamos a un(a) Analista de Customer Success que sea el enlace operativo con nuestras empresas clientes: que dé seguimiento a sus solicitudes, las mantenga informadas sobre el estado de su servicio y coordine con nuestros equipos internos para darles una respuesta oportuna.




Es un rol de servicio, seguimiento y reportes, sin cuota de ventas.




¿Qué harás?

- Ser el primer punto de contacto de empresas clientes para consultas sobre el servicio, el estado de sus proveedores y sus indicadores.

- Registrar y dar seguimiento a tickets e incidencias hasta su cierre, coordinándote con Operaciones, Validación de Datos y Sistemas.

- Elaborar reportes periódicos de desempeño del servicio (KPIs, riesgos y estado de proveedores).

- Preparar y participar en reuniones de seguimiento con clientes, y documentar acuerdos y próximos pasos en minutas.

- Mantener actualizada la información de clientes en nuestras herramientas internas.

- Identificar necesidades o nuevas oportunidades de los clientes y canalizarlas al área comercial.

- Proponer mejoras en los procesos de atención y reporte.




¿Qué buscamos?

- Más de 3 años de experiencia en customer success, soporte a clientes empresariales, atención a cuentas B2B o funciones similares.

- Excel intermedio para elaborar reportes.

- Redacción clara y profesional de correos, minutas y reportes.

- Organización para dar seguimiento a varias solicitudes y prioridades a la vez.

- Orientación al cliente y facilidad para coordinarte con distintas áreas.

- Deseable: manejo de CRM o sistemas de tickets.

- Deseable: experiencia en empresas de servicios B2B o plataformas digitales.

- Plus: inglés básico-intermedio.

- Estudios Indispensables: Licenciatura con Titulo en Administración, Negocios Internacionales, Ingeniería Industrial, Relaciones Internacionales, Comunicación o afines




¿Qué ofrecemos?

- Prestaciones superiores a las de ley.

- Contratación directa con empresa 

- Capacitación inicial en nuestra plataforma y procesos.

- Modalidad Híbrida

- Desarrollo en una empresa global enfocada en sostenibilidad y gestión de riesgos en la cadena de suministro.




Sobre Achilles

Durante más de 30 años, Achilles ha protegido los intereses comerciales y la reputación de las organizaciones al proporcionar transparencia en la cadena de suministro, gestión de riesgos, ESG y reducción de carbono. Trabajamos con organizaciones líderes de los sectores financiero, industrial, comercial y gubernamental, con presencia en 22 ubicaciones alrededor del mundo.

description:
About the job

Ubicación: Aguascalientes, México

Horario de trabajo y modalidad: Tiempo completo, presencial

Requisito de educación: Licenciatura o Ingeniería concluida

Únete y lidera la innovación con nosotros. Actualmente estamos buscando un Staff de Facilities y Servicios Generales para unirse a nuestro equipo en Aguascalientes.

Esta posición es responsable de garantizar la correcta operación de los servicios generales de planta mediante la coordinación y supervisión de proveedores, el seguimiento al presupuesto asignado y el cumplimiento de los estándares de seguridad, calidad y servicio. El rol contribuye a mantener instalaciones funcionales, seguras y eficientes para el personal y las operaciones de la planta.

Un día en la vida de este rol:


Supervisar y coordinar proveedores de servicios como limpieza, fumigación, control de plagas, mensajería, abastecimiento de agua y mantenimiento de instalaciones. 
Administrar presupuestos, facturación, inventarios de insumos y seguimiento de gastos indirectos relacionados con Facilities. 
Coordinar actividades de mantenimiento preventivo de mobiliario, equipos de limpieza e infraestructura de servicios. 
Atender auditorías internas y externas, recorridos de planta, eventos y requerimientos de clientes internos. 
Elaborar planes de trabajo, reportes operativos y seguimiento a indicadores de desempeño de los servicios contratados. 


A quién buscamos:

Obligatorio:


Licenciatura o Ingeniería concluida. 
Experiencia mínima de 1 año en Facilities, Servicios Generales, Administración de Proveedores o posiciones similares. 
Experiencia coordinando proveedores y dando seguimiento a servicios operativos. 
Conocimiento en administración de información, control de gastos y atención a clientes internos. 


Deseable:


Conocimiento en auditorías ISO 9001, seguridad y medio ambiente. 
Experiencia en control presupuestal, gestión de compras y administración de activos. 
Experiencia en entornos industriales o de manufactura. 


Lo que esperarás en Nissan:

Crecimiento profesional y oportunidades de aprendizaje continuo: Beneficio de diversas trayectorias profesionales, movimientos interdepartamentales y plataformas de aprendizaje innovadoras. Mejore sus habilidades a través de seminarios y capacitación en liderazgo, todo mientras desempeña un papel vital en darle forma al futuro de la movilidad. Desde el primer día, tendrá el apoyo para enfrentar los desafíos y contribuir a soluciones impactantes en toda nuestra organización.

Compensaciones: Nissan ofrece un paquete integral de beneficios para apoyar el bienestar y el éxito de nuestros empleados, con ofertas que pueden variar según la ubicación y el rol.

Nissan (NMEX,NEdM, NRFS, NRFM y ANZEN) contrata con base en el cumplimiento del perfil laboral en la vacante, sin distinción o discriminación por motivos de género, identidad y/o expresión de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, idioma, religión, opinión política o de cualquier otra índole, origen nacional o social, posición económica, nacimiento o cualquier otra condición.

Al postularse para el puesto anunciado, los candidatos reconocen que Nissan Mexicana y sus subsidiarias se reservan el derecho de realizar una búsqueda de conducta pública debido a la naturaleza sensible de los activos y la información involucrada en el puesto. Esto incluye, entre otros, información de propiedad, datos financieros y otros activos que requieren protección. Nissan Mexicana y sus subsidiarias garantizan la confidencialidad y el cumplimiento de todos los requisitos legales relacionados con el uso de dicha información. Al solicitar este puesto, está dando su consentimiento a esta comprobación.

NISSAN PARA TODOS

Las personas son nuestros activos más valiosos, y Nissan busca maximizar el potencial de cada integrante de nuestro equipo. Cuando todos forman parte, el poder de NISSAN es innegable. Nissan busca mejorar los resultados del negocio mediante un lugar de trabajo y un negocio que satisfacen las necesidades de nuestros empleados y nuestra base de clientes.

Nissan está comprometido con crear una cultura en la que todos forman parte y los empleados, clientes y socios se sienten respetados, valorados y escuchados. Tenemos Equipos de Sinergia de Negocio (BSTs) en todo el continente americano que están abiertos a todos los empleados y buscan conectar a los empleados por medio de intereses frecuentes y fomentar una cultura empresarial en la que todos los empleados se sientan apoyados e incluidos.

Nissan también valora la inclusión en nuestro negocio, ya que respetamos y reconocemos la diversidad de nuestra base de clientes y de las comunidades donde hacemos negocio. Estamos comprometidos con adquirir bienes y servicios innovadores, comercializar nuestros productos y comunicarnos desde una posición que nos ayudará a seguir ofreciendo a nuestros clientes productos diseñados de manera competitiva e impulsados por el mercado.

Acompáñenos mientras llevamos nuestro compromiso con nuestros empleados y clientes hacia el futuro.

description:
About the job

Job Description

Ford Champs will allow to get to now different business areas through 12 months, while you improve your skills and become a better professional.

As a CX Ford Champ, you will play a key role between corporate strategy and dealer execution. You will assist with the review and submission of dealer certification results turning them into actionable insights. You will support activities into actionable insights through data and foster a culture of excellence by supporting our CX Ambassadors. Your work will directly impact how Ford customers interact with the brand, ensuring every touchpoint is optimized for satisfaction and loyalty.

Responsibilities


Supporting the Dealer Network CX Certification project, including the review, consolidation, and submission of results from audits, mystery shopper evaluations, and dealer action plans.
Assisting in the implementation and measurement of the regional Customer Experience strategy.
Developing internal reports and high-impact PowerPoint presentations for executive leadership and the dealer network.
Creating reference materials and guides (e.g., process guides, playbooks, and best-practice documents) to support dealer certification and CX initiatives.
Supporting the review, evaluation, and optimization of sales and service surveys to ensure data quality.
Coordinating and facilitating monthly presentations and sessions for the CX Ambassadors program.
Conducting functional testing for digital platforms, with a specific focus on the Online Service Booking (OSB) system.
Supporting month-end closing processes and tracking Net Promoter Score (NPS) performance and trends.
Designing visual communication materials, such as infographics, to provide strategic support to Dealers.
Managing content updates and maintenance for the FMCDealer portal.
Leveraging AI tools and data management practices to streamline data analysis, automate reporting, and generate actionable insights from CX data sources.



Qualifications

Education: Active student currently enrolled in the last 2 semesters of a degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field.

Languages: Business English proficiency, 90% (Advanced oral, reading, writing, and listening skills).

Analytical Skills: Strong ability to interpret data, identify trends, and generate concise reports; basic knowledge of data management and AI tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel advanced functions, ChatGPT/Copilot) to support data analysis and reporting is a plus.

Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for interacting with internal stakeholders and dealer management.

Core Competencies:


Proven ability to work effectively in collaborative team environments.
Strong leadership potential and a proactive, self-starting attitude.
Multitasking and organizational skills to manage competing priorities.
An innovative mindset with a focus on continuous process improvement, including curiosity for AI and data-driven tools.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint and Excel are essential) and basic graphic design awareness.
Familiarity with data management concepts and interest in applying AI to improve reporting and analysis.

title: Trafficker Digital (Meta + Google/YouTube Ads)
skills: Diseñar junto conmigo la estrategia de tráfico pagado.
Crear, lanzar y optimizar campañas en Meta Ads (principal) y Google/YouTube Ads.
Optimizar cuentas 3–4 veces por semana y correr un plan de pruebas estructurado (ganchos, creativos, audiencias, ofertas).
Construir y ajustar embudos con las herramientas de IA de HighLevel (yo te doy los activos: videos, copy, oferta).
Escribir correos y montar automatizaciones de email/WhatsApp para nutrir leads dentro del embudo.
Escribir briefs creativos y trabajar mano a mano con nuestro editor de video para producir anuncios; participar en la ideación de ganchos y ángulos.
Implementar y mantener el tracking completo: Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), eventos y UTMs, para saber exactamente qué anuncio produjo cada lead, cada compra y cada cliente.
Entregar un reporte semanal de una página con decisiones, no solo números.
Mucha experiencia comprobada como trafficker digital para infoproductos, marcas personales, coaching, educación online o software. Ese es nuestro nicho y necesitamos que ya lo conozcas.
Experiencia en embudos evergreen (tráfico frío todos los días), no solo en lanzamientos.

Haber gestionado más de $5,000 USD al mes en pauta con resultados positivos que puedas demostrar (capturas o grabaciones de pantalla de Ads Manager con contexto: objetivo, gasto, ventas generadas). No nos sirve "gasté el presupuesto"; nos sirve "lo convertí en clientes".
Dominio de tracking: Pixel, CAPI, eventos personalizados y atribución. Esto es requisito, no deseable.
Experiencia usando un CRM como HighLevel (idealmente HighLevel): embudos, automatizaciones, pipelines.
Capacidad de escribir briefs claros para video y copy directo para anuncios y correos.
Interés genuino por la industria de la educación online, el software y el marketing digital.
Español nativo o equivalente (la audiencia es de habla hispana).
Plus: experiencia con productos low ticket (SLO), con programas de afiliados o con campañas de YouTube Ads para crecer canales.
Base: $1,200 USD mensuales.

Comisión: 20% de la primera comisión mensual que HighLevel nos pague por cada cliente que el tráfico convierta. Ejemplo: si un cliente nos genera $118 USD en su primer mes, tú recibes $23.60 por ese cliente. Sin tope. Mientras más clientes conviertas, más ganas.
Las cuentas publicitarias y el presupuesto de pauta son nuestros; tú los operas con autonomía.
Alrededor de 20 horas por semana.
Sin horario fijo: organizas tu tiempo como quieras. Solo tienes que unirte a las llamadas del equipo.
100% remoto, desde tu casa, en cualquier país de Latinoamérica o España.
Relación directa conmigo, sin agencias ni intermediarios.
Presupuesto de pauta creciente: empezamos probando y escalamos lo que funcione.
Has hecho crecer negocios de infoproductos, coaching o software con tráfico pagado y lo puedes demostrar con números de ventas.
Piensas en embudos completos (anuncio → lead → compra → cliente), no solo en el CPM.
Te gusta proponer, probar y equivocarte rápido.
Puedes explicar por qué funcionó un anuncio, no solo que funcionó.
Solo has hecho e-commerce o negocios locales y nunca has vendido educación, servicios o software.
Solo has trabajado lanzamientos y nunca has sostenido un embudo evergreen.
No puedes mostrar resultados reales de cuentas que hayas manejado.
Eres agencia o quieres cobrar un porcentaje del gasto publicitario: buscamos una persona, no un proveedor.
Necesitas que te digan exactamente qué hacer cada día.
Tu plan para escalar incluye prometer ingresos o "trucos" para saltarte las políticas de las plataformas.
description:
About the job

Buscamos un trafficker digital con experiencia real en infoproductos que convierta nuestro contenido educativo en un sistema de tráfico pagado que genere clientes. No es un puesto de "subir campañas": es diseñar, probar, medir y escalar un embudo evergreen completo, con un objetivo de negocio muy claro.




Quiénes somos




Soy Rodrigo Camacho, creador de contenido y educador para emprendedores de habla hispana. Desde YouTube y nuestras comunidades enseñamos a miles de personas en Latinoamérica a crear negocios digitales y agencias usando HighLevel, el software de marketing del que somos afiliados #1 en Latinoamérica en español. Tenemos una comunidad gratuita de más de 32,000 miembros y un programa de formación con más de 500 emprendedores activos. Hasta hoy hemos crecido 100% orgánico. Ahora vamos a invertir en tráfico pagado de forma seria y necesitamos a quien lo lidere.




El objetivo del puesto




Generar clientes para HighLevel a través de nuestro enlace de afiliado. Vamos a promocionar contenido y productos educativos en Meta Ads y Google/YouTube Ads, llevar a las personas a un embudo evergreen (recurso gratuito → producto de entrada → nutrición por correo/WhatsApp) y convertirlas en usuarios activos de HighLevel. Tu trabajo se mide por cuántos clientes reales salen del tráfico, no por impresiones ni por presupuesto gastado.




Qué vas a hacer




Diseñar junto conmigo la estrategia de tráfico pagado.
Crear, lanzar y optimizar campañas en Meta Ads (principal) y Google/YouTube Ads.
Optimizar cuentas 3–4 veces por semana y correr un plan de pruebas estructurado (ganchos, creativos, audiencias, ofertas).
Construir y ajustar embudos con las herramientas de IA de HighLevel (yo te doy los activos: videos, copy, oferta).
Escribir correos y montar automatizaciones de email/WhatsApp para nutrir leads dentro del embudo.
Escribir briefs creativos y trabajar mano a mano con nuestro editor de video para producir anuncios; participar en la ideación de ganchos y ángulos.
Implementar y mantener el tracking completo: Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), eventos y UTMs, para saber exactamente qué anuncio produjo cada lead, cada compra y cada cliente.
Entregar un reporte semanal de una página con decisiones, no solo números.




Qué medimos




Costo por lead, costo por comprador del producto de entrada, retorno del front-end y, sobre todo, clientes de HighLevel generados por el tráfico. En cuánto se convirtió la inversión en ventas: esa es la métrica que importa.




Lo que buscamos




Mucha experiencia comprobada como trafficker digital para infoproductos, marcas personales, coaching, educación online o software. Ese es nuestro nicho y necesitamos que ya lo conozcas.
Experiencia en embudos evergreen (tráfico frío todos los días), no solo en lanzamientos.
Haber gestionado más de $5,000 USD al mes en pauta con resultados positivos que puedas demostrar (capturas o grabaciones de pantalla de Ads Manager con contexto: objetivo, gasto, ventas generadas). No nos sirve "gasté el presupuesto"; nos sirve "lo convertí en clientes".
Dominio de tracking: Pixel, CAPI, eventos personalizados y atribución. Esto es requisito, no deseable.
Experiencia usando un CRM como HighLevel (idealmente HighLevel): embudos, automatizaciones, pipelines.
Capacidad de escribir briefs claros para video y copy directo para anuncios y correos.
Interés genuino por la industria de la educación online, el software y el marketing digital.
Español nativo o equivalente (la audiencia es de habla hispana).
Plus: experiencia con productos low ticket (SLO), con programas de afiliados o con campañas de YouTube Ads para crecer canales.




Cómo pagamos




Base: $1,200 USD mensuales.
Comisión: 20% de la primera comisión mensual que HighLevel nos pague por cada cliente que el tráfico convierta. Ejemplo: si un cliente nos genera $118 USD en su primer mes, tú recibes $23.60 por ese cliente. Sin tope. Mientras más clientes conviertas, más ganas.
Las cuentas publicitarias y el presupuesto de pauta son nuestros; tú los operas con autonomía.




Condiciones

Alrededor de 20 horas por semana.
Sin horario fijo: organizas tu tiempo como quieras. Solo tienes que unirte a las llamadas del equipo.
100% remoto, desde tu casa, en cualquier país de Latinoamérica o España.
Relación directa conmigo, sin agencias ni intermediarios.
Presupuesto de pauta creciente: empezamos probando y escalamos lo que funcione.




Sí queremos que apliques si

Has hecho crecer negocios de infoproductos, coaching o software con tráfico pagado y lo puedes demostrar con números de ventas.
Piensas en embudos completos (anuncio → lead → compra → cliente), no solo en el CPM.
Te gusta proponer, probar y equivocarte rápido.
Puedes explicar por qué funcionó un anuncio, no solo que funcionó.




No apliques si

Solo has hecho e-commerce o negocios locales y nunca has vendido educación, servicios o software.
Solo has trabajado lanzamientos y nunca has sostenido un embudo evergreen.
No puedes mostrar resultados reales de cuentas que hayas manejado.
Eres agencia o quieres cobrar un porcentaje del gasto publicitario: buscamos una persona, no un proveedor.
Necesitas que te digan exactamente qué hacer cada día.
Tu plan para escalar incluye prometer ingresos o "trucos" para saltarte las políticas de las plataformas.




Cómo aplicar




Aplica a través de nuestro portal. Completa el formulario, revisaremos tu respuesta y te contestaremos con nuestra decisión.




Proceso: formulario → prueba práctica → entrevista por videollamada con pantalla compartida → 30 días de prueba.

description:
About the job

About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

The Nigeria program, established in 2018, is headquartered in Minna, Niger state. We're currently serving over 100,000 unique farmers across the state via our inputs on credit 'Core' program, inputs on cash 'Retail' program, and have a free tree seedling distribution 'Agroforestry' program. To learn more about our work, look at our Nigeria program blog.

About The Role

This role ensures OAF Nigeria's expansion and business innovation agenda delivers on its 2030 ambition by identifying and validating new geographies and revenue opportunities, leading the end-to-end entry of new states from scouting through to operational handover, and building the commercial models that make each new market financially sustainable from day one.

Responsibilities

Strategy and Business Innovation


You will design OAF Nigeria's 5-year expansion and business innovation strategy, identifying new geographies, new revenue streams, and new commercial models that reduce dependence on any single income line and support the path to financial sustainability.
You will drive from strategy to a concrete annual plan — translating the long-term ambition into sequenced state entries, product and service trials, and business model validations with clear timelines and owners.


Expansion Execution


You will lead the end-to-end entry of new states — from security risk assessment and field scouting through site setup, stakeholder engagement, first-season farmer enrollment, and handover to the Regional Lead.
You will manage the expansion operations calendar, aligning scouting, SRA, state confirmation, infrastructure setup, and planting season windows so that no gate is missed and no entry is made without validated evidence.


People Management and Coaching


You will manage a team of four permanent staff, ensuring each person has clear goals, regular feedback, and a development path.
You will be a senior leader within the Programs Division, providing cross-departmental support through coaching and mentoring of mid-level staff, and helping to build the next generation of State Operations Leads and Regional Leads from within the expansion team.


Monitoring and Reporting


You will develop and track KPIs across all active expansion states and business innovation trials — including farmer enrollment rates, first-season repayment performance, gross margin per farmer, revenue per trial state, and new product uptake against target.
You will produce timely, actionable reports and communicate risks, progress, and go/no-go recommendations to the Head of Programs, Country Director, and Steerco — with the clarity and data quality expected of someone operating at the interface between field execution and organisational strategy.


Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

We seek a professional with over 7 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years leading cross-functional teams and working across multiple departments, combined with a passion for building commercially sustainable agricultural programmes that serve smallholder farmers.


Strategic thinking: Ability to translate a long-term ambition into a sequenced, evidence-based growth plan
Commercial acumen: Experience identifying, designing, and validating new revenue opportunities — products, services, or business models — in complex or resource-constrained environments
Project management: Ability to design, plan, and run multiple complex projects simultaneously to successful outcomes
Growth mindset: Enthusiasm for learning, feedback, and continuous improvement in the face of ambiguity
Results-oriented: You set goals, take ownership, and hold yourself and your team accountable for delivering them
Cross-functional fluency: You collaborate effectively with colleagues across programmes, finance, operations, and external partners
Strong educational background; minimum Bachelor's Degree, postgraduate qualification preferred
Willingness to be based in Minna, Niger State, with significant field travel across expansion states for periods of up to 18 months per assignment
English required; Hausa speaking strongly preferred


Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Minna, Niger State, Nigeria - Onsite

Benefits

Health insurance, housing, and comprehensive benefits

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Nigeria

Application Deadline

16th October, 2026. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @oneacrefund.org address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

About the job

Company Overview

MegaEvolution Company Introduction Deck: https://drive.google.com/file/d/14d_MvV0Pnbza9FyGEwwdJ7lQUvquO5-L/view?usp=sharing




About Quokka

Quokka(MegaEvolution) is an AI-native global MCN & influencer marketing agency that connects brands and creators across international markets. We integrate AI and automation into our day-to-day operations, from creator discovery and campaign management to content analysis, reporting, and internal workflows, enabling our team to operate efficiently across multiple markets.




Our team is made up of talented professionals from Korea, Japan, the United States, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, and beyond. Each team member leads initiatives within their local market, bringing regional expertise while collaborating on global projects.




As a fast-growing startup, we encourage every team member to actively leverage AI to improve how we work, automate repetitive processes, and build new systems from the ground up. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership from day one, experiment with new AI-powered workflows, and contribute directly to the growth of an international business.




Our Vision

To become the leading AI-powered cross-border creator ecosystem, helping brands and creators grow beyond cultural and market boundaries.

This position sits primarily within Quokka MCN, our creator management division. Quokka also works closely with MegaEvolution, our partner influencer marketing agency. While your primary focus will be growing Quokka's creator network, you'll also support MegaEvolution's influencer campaigns and creator partnerships when needed.




Position Summary

We're looking for a proactive and commercially minded Talent Manager to lead creator acquisition and talent management within Spanish-speaking countries.

You'll own the creator lifecycle—from identifying promising creators and building relationships to negotiating partnerships, onboarding talent and supporting ongoing campaign opportunities.

Alongside your core MCN responsibilities, you'll occasionally assist MegaEvolution with influencer campaign coordination and creator communications, making this role ideal for someone who enjoys both talent management and client-facing campaign operations.




Key ResponsibilitiesQuokka MCN (Primary Responsibilities)

Identify and recruit high-potential creators across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube using performance metrics, audience insights, and content quality.
Build and manage a structured creator outreach pipeline using the company's CRM and internal systems.
Develop market-specific sourcing strategies based on local trends, creator niches, and platform behaviour.
Present Quokka's creator program and negotiate partnership terms with prospective creators.
Prepare commercial proposals using regional pricing frameworks while maintaining healthy business margins.
Coordinate creator contracts and invoices.
Manage creator onboarding, including documentation, profile setup, media kits, and onboarding milestones.
Maintain accurate creator records, rate cards, and communication history within internal databases.
Source out brand partnerships and recommend suitable creators for campaign opportunities.
Build long-term relationships with signed creators, ensuring consistent communication and ongoing engagement.




MegaEvolution (Secondary Responsibilities)

As business needs require, you may also:

Support influencer campaign execution for brand clients.
Coordinate creator communications throughout campaign delivery.
Assist with creator onboarding onto the MegaEvolution platform.
Conduct outreach to prospective creators and clients.
Support campaign reporting, scheduling, documentation, and administrative tasks.




Shared Responsibilities

Monitor influencer marketing trends, platform updates, and creator economy developments within your assigned market.
Work closely with cross-functional teams across Quokka and MegaEvolution.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve internal workflows and creator operations.




Work Arrangement

Employment Type: Independent Contractor

Location: Remote (with occasional in-person meetings)

Working Hours: Full-time (8 hours/day, Mon – Sat), Flexible

Start Date: As soon as possible (pre-onboarding of up to four weeks may be available where required).

Compensation: 700-800 USD




・Performance and compensation are reviewed every six months or annually based on individual performance and company growth.

・National holidays, plus 3 days of leave every 3 months.




What We Offer

Ownership of creator recruitment and talent management within your assigned market.
Opportunities to work with creators and brands across Southeast Asia and international markets.
Exposure to both MCN operations and agency-side influencer marketing campaigns.
Performance-based incentives that reward long-term contribution (eligible after one year).
A collaborative international team with significant autonomy and opportunities for professional growth.
The ability to make a measurable impact in a rapidly growing company.
Flexible work arrangement.
Remote-first flexibility – Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere with a flexible schedule, eliminating daily commuting and associated costs while giving you greater control over your work-life balance.




Required Qualifications

2–4 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, talent management, or account management.
Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube creator ecosystems.
Familiarity with influencer pricing models, campaign budgeting, and commercial negotiations.
Excellent organizational skills with experience managing large databases or CRM systems (Notion, Airtable, Google Sheets, Excel, etc.).
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build relationships across different cultures.
Professional working proficiency in English.
Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote working environment.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.




Preferred Qualifications

Native or professional proficiency in English and Spanish.
Additional proficiency in Mandarin, Japanese, or Korean.
Experience working within an MCN, influencer agency, creator platform, or startup.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.




Our Values

Integrity and honesty
Ownership and accountability
Clear and proactive communication
Continuous learning and self-improvement
Collaboration across cultures
Professionalism
Adaptability and initiative
Strong digital literacy

description:
About the job

Job Description

Marketing Analyst | EF Language Abroad

What if your next role actually changed lives, including your own?

At EF Language Abroad, we believe that learning a language abroad is one of the most transformative experiences a person can have. And we need passionate, driven people to help make that happen. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Marketing Analyst to join our team in Polanco, Mexico. This is your chance to grow your career in a global company, work alongside an energetic and ambitious team, and help shape the way young people discover life changing experiences abroad.

You'll be at the heart of our digital presence: creating content, managing campaigns, and turning data into insights that drive real results. No two days look the same, just creative work, real impact, and a team that's genuinely rooting for you from day one.

Your Main Responsibilities

Digital Marketing


 Plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across social media, email, and other digital channels. 
 Manage the brand's social media channels, including content scheduling, posting, and community engagement. 
 Monitor campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights and recommendations. 


Content Creation


 Develop engaging content for social media, email marketing, blogs, and other digital platforms. 
 Support the creation and localization of global marketing materials for the local market. 
 Review and ensure all content is aligned with brand guidelines and tone of voice. 


Analytics and Reporting


 Track and report on key marketing KPIs, providing regular performance updates to the team. 
 Use data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. 
 Support A/B testing and other optimization initiatives. 


Collaboration


 Work closely with the sales team to align marketing efforts with business goals. 
 Collaborate with global marketing teams to adapt and localize campaigns. 
 Support the planning and execution of events and promotional actions. 


Requirements


 Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. 
 Previous experience in digital marketing or content creation. 
 Proficiency in English. Additional languages are a plus. 
 Hands on experience with social media management tools, CRM, and analytics platforms. 
 Strong eye for design and familiarity with tools like Canva, Adobe, or equivalent. 
 Data driven mindset with strong analytical and communication skills. 
 Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast paced international environment. 


Why You Will Love Working with Us

More than just a job, we offer a career, and the benefits grow with you.

From Day One, All EF Team Members Enjoy


 Benefits by local law 
 Corporate benefits discounts 
 Staff referral bonus (500 USD) 
 EF Hello App 
 Access to the Mental Health App "Foundation" 


As a Marketing Analyst, You Also Unlock


 Global Mobile Office 
 National KO recognition 
 EF Summer Helper Nomination: 1 week as a group helper abroad 
 Famtrip Nomination: travel to the USA 


As you grow through our career ladder, even more doors open. Depending on your level, you may also unlock:


 Intercontinental Famtrip nominations 
 Free language courses and international training nominations 
 Hub Office visits with training and networking opportunities 
 Leadership development programs and international kickoffs 


 Benefits vary by career level and are subject to local labor laws and business eligibility criteria. 

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

About The Team

At EF Language Abroad, we believe that the world is better when people try to understand one another. Since 1965, we've helped millions of students discover new places, embrace diverse cultures, and gain fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to our mission of opening the world through education, harnessing the power of language learning to deepen the connection between people across the globe.

We offer immersive short-term and long-term language courses and programs across different languages in the countries where they’re spoken. Through blending classroom-based lessons with interactive exercises and real-world practice, our courses bring you to the heart of the language. Together, our global staff help students from around the world develop the language skills they need to achieve their dreams.

EF is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults. All positions are subject to a criminal background and/or reference checks, as applicable.

About the job

GoHighLevel Marketing Operations Specialist




Location: Latin America - Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Schedule: Part-time initially – approximately 20 hours/week, with potential to expand

Start Date: As soon as possible




About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on GoHighLevel Marketing Operations Specialist to build, manage, and continuously improve the marketing infrastructure for a growing organization.

This is a technical marketing operations role, not a general Virtual Assistant or content-writing position. You will be responsible for turning marketing strategies and campaigns into reliable, functioning systems inside GoHighLevel.

You will work closely with the marketing and digital strategy team, who will provide direction on messaging, campaign strategy, SEO priorities, and lead-scoring strategy. Your responsibility will be to configure, execute, test, troubleshoot, document, and optimize the underlying marketing systems and workflows.

The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, technically capable, comfortable working independently, and able to identify potential issues before they affect a live campaign.

Key Responsibilities

GoHighLevel Administration

Administer and maintain GoHighLevel agency and sub-account environments.
Build and maintain workflows, automations, pipelines, tags, triggers, forms, calendars, and email templates.
Configure and maintain CRM structures and marketing processes.
Ensure GoHighLevel systems remain organized, accurate, and scalable.
Manage multiple brands, campaigns, and sub-accounts when required.

CRM & Data Management

Maintain clean and accurate contact databases.
Manage list hygiene, segmentation, tagging, and lifecycle statuses.
Configure lead-routing rules to ensure leads reach the appropriate destination.
Maintain accurate source attribution and campaign tracking.
Identify and correct data inconsistencies, duplicate records, missing fields, and routing issues.
Help establish standardized naming conventions and data structures.

Email Marketing & Automation

Build reusable email campaign templates for newsletters, lead nurturing, webinar promotions, follow-up campaigns, re-engagement campaigns, and other recurring marketing campaigns.
Schedule, test, launch, and monitor email campaigns using content supplied by the marketing team.
Build automated nurture sequences and lifecycle-based communications.
Test email triggers, links, personalization, segmentation, and delivery before campaigns go live.
Monitor campaign performance and identify technical or operational issues.

Webinar Marketing Operations

Configure webinar registration workflows.
Build automated webinar reminder sequences.
Set up attendance and registration tracking.
Create follow-up workflows based on registration, attendance, non-attendance, drop-off, and engagement.
Configure lead routing and segmentation based on webinar activity.
Build reusable webinar campaign templates that can be replicated for future events.
Work with WebinarKit or comparable webinar platforms.

Website & Landing Page Operations

Support the technical administration of GoHighLevel-hosted websites and landing pages.
Configure and maintain website forms.
Ensure form submissions are correctly captured in GoHighLevel.
Configure appropriate tags, source attribution, and lead routing.
Support implementation of metadata, structured schema, tracking codes, UTM parameters, and website analytics.
Identify opportunities to improve website tracking and page performance.

Lead Scoring & MQL Management

Implement lead-scoring and marketing-qualified-lead workflows based on the marketing team's strategy.
Configure MQL thresholds and routing rules.
Set up notifications and automated actions based on lead activity.
Maintain lifecycle stages and qualification criteria.
Monitor lead-scoring performance and help refine workflows based on campaign data.

Integrations & Troubleshooting

Configure and maintain marketing technology integrations.
Work with native integrations, APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Make, or similar automation tools.
Support integrations involving GA4, AWS SES, social platforms, website tracking, email systems, CRM, and marketing platforms.
Investigate data synchronization problems and integration failures.
Troubleshoot email events, including delivery issues and hard-bounce data that may not properly sync into GoHighLevel.
Identify the root cause of technical issues and implement reliable solutions.

Reporting & Analytics

Build and maintain practical marketing dashboards and reports.
Track email performance, campaign results, website traffic, lead sources, MQL activity, lead conversion, webinar performance, and marketing pipeline activity.
Ensure reporting data is accurate and properly attributed.
Help identify gaps in tracking and reporting.
Use performance data to recommend operational improvements.

Documentation & Process Improvement

Document workflows, automations, integrations, naming conventions, and processes.
Create repeatable procedures for campaigns and webinars.
Maintain clear documentation so systems can be easily understood and managed by other team members.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
Establish processes that reduce manual work and prevent recurring errors.

Required Qualifications

Strong, hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL/HighLevel).
Demonstrated experience building and managing workflows, automations, pipelines, tags, triggers, forms, calendars, email campaigns, and sub-accounts.
Experience implementing marketing operations systems rather than simply using GoHighLevel as a basic CRM.
Experience with CRM/database management.
Strong understanding of contact segmentation and lifecycle management.
Experience building email automation and nurture sequences.
Practical experience with webinar marketing workflows.
Working knowledge of website tracking, forms, GA4, UTM parameters, and marketing analytics.
Ability to configure and troubleshoot integrations using Zapier, Make, webhooks, APIs, or similar tools.
Strong attention to detail and testing discipline.
Ability to troubleshoot technical and operational issues independently.
Clear written and spoken English.
Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with WebinarKit or comparable webinar platforms.
Familiarity with AWS SES and email deliverability.
Experience with technical SEO/AEO implementation.
Understanding of metadata and structured schema.
Experience managing multiple GoHighLevel brands or sub-accounts.
Experience migrating or rebuilding marketing operations following a HubSpot-to-GoHighLevel transition.
Experience with dashboarding and reporting tools beyond GoHighLevel.
Background supporting B2B SaaS, consulting, professional services, or event/conference marketing.
Experience with lead scoring and MQL lifecycle management.
Experience working with marketing technology stacks and integrations.




What Success Looks Like

During the first 60–90 days, the successful candidate will help establish a clean, reliable, and scalable GoHighLevel marketing environment.




Success will include:

Clean and dependable data structures.
Proper contact segmentation and tagging.
Reliable lead routing and lifecycle management.
Reusable email campaign and nurture workflows.
Repeatable webinar registration and follow-up workflows.
Properly configured forms and website tracking.
Accurate source attribution.
Functional marketing dashboards.
Improved visibility into email, website, campaign, and MQL performance.
Clear documentation of workflows and processes.
Identification and prioritization of gaps involving GA4, AWS SES, website tracking, and future marketing integrations.




Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys working behind the scenes of marketing systems and is comfortable getting into the technical details.

You should be someone who can take a marketing requirement such as:

"We need to capture webinar registrants, send reminders, identify attendees, route qualified leads, and follow up with people who didn't attend."

—and independently turn that requirement into a fully functioning, tested GoHighLevel workflow.

You should be comfortable asking questions when requirements are unclear, testing your work before launch, troubleshooting when something breaks, and documenting what you've built.

This role is best suited for someone who considers themselves a GoHighLevel Specialist, Marketing Automation Specialist, Marketing Operations Specialist, CRM Automation Specialist, or similar technical marketing professional rather than a general VA or content marketer.
