About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Joining the Driver Growth team offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the growth of one of the fastest-growing companies. This role is driven by data analytics, quality management, and operational problem-solving, and requires a combination of strong analytical thinking, a builder's mindset, and the ability to work across countries and stakeholders. You'll work closely with a dedicated team to monitor, understand, and improve DiDi's driver experience across all Spanish-speaking LATAM (SSL) regions. Expect a fast-paced, dynamic, and challenging environment with never a dull moment!

Driver Growth plays a crucial role in DiDi's continued expansion throughout SSL by focusing on strategies for acquiring, converting, and retaining supply — this role sits at the heart of understanding why supply moves the way it does, and turning that understanding into action.

In this role, you'll be...


Own end-to-end analysis of driver quality, conversion, and retention across SSL countries — from root-cause diagnosis to actionable recommendations.
Build and maintain the tools the team runs on daily: dashboards, forecasting models, and reporting. Using AI-assisted development to move fast.
Track and report core KPIs by country/city/product line.
Partner with regional and cross-functional stakeholders (product, operations, incentives, CX) to design, test, and refine incentive and retention programs.
Coordinate document and data-quality processes across countries, identifying anomalies and driving fixes with local teams.
Present findings and recommendations directly to senior stakeholders, translating complex analysis into clear, decision-ready narratives.
Drive AI adoption within the team: build your own workflows and tools with AI, and help train and upskill teammates.
Take on informal people-development opportunities — coaching junior teammates or interns to independently own parts of the operation



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

The ability to turn ambiguous, messy problems into rigorous analysis and clear, actionable plans — grounded in data, not assumptions. You bring strong analytical and quantitative skills, hands-on experience building tools or dashboards (bonus if AI-assisted), and the intellectual honesty to name a miss, diagnose its root cause, and build the fix yourself. You're comfortable coordinating across countries and functions, communicate complex findings simply to senior audiences, and take pride in constructing durable assets — not just one-off reports — that the team relies on every day.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
About the job

Job Description

Why GM Financial?

GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. We also offer commercial lending products to dealers to help them finance and grow their businesses.

At GM Financial, our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes new ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive.

Our Purpose: We pioneer the innovations that move and connect people to what matters.

This position will be posted until filled.

Responsibilities

About the role:

The IO CX Management Senior Specialist (P4) owns the operational administration, governance, data strategy, quality, and analytical enablement of the International Operations (IO) Voice of the Customer (VoC) ecosystem.

The position will combine advanced analytics with experience and operational data to transform structured and unstructured customer feedback into statistical findings and actionable insights that inform priorities, strengthen decision-making, and improve customer and business outcomes.

Also, it serves as the technical and analytical expert for Qualtrics XM Engage and XM Discover, related reporting platforms, and the controlled integration of experience, operational, digital, and conversational data. With solid understanding of data sources, data flows, data architecture and tools, it establishes and strengths the data strategy, data standards and data governance to be aligned with the corporate policies and standards.

The role directs cross-functional delivery without requiring formal authority, manages risks and dependencies, coaches platform users and analytical partners, and is accountable for the reliability, scalability, adoption, and continuous improvement of CXM data products and platforms across IO markets.

In This Role You Will


 CXM Data Strategy and Governance


Own and execute the VoC data strategy roadmap, translating the approved CXM strategy into governed capabilities, milestones, controls, and measurable outcomes across IO markets.

Establish and maintain standards for VoC data architecture, taxonomy, metadata, metric definitions, access, retention, lineage, documentation, and change control.

Integrate experience data with operational, digital, transactional, and conversational inputs to improve insight quality and enable Qualtrics as the controlled source of truth for VoC.

Lead structured pilots of modern data and AI capabilities, including Databricks and Qualtrics AI, with documented use cases, validation criteria, risks, controls, and adoption recommendations.

Partner with CX IO, IT, Business Intelligence, Privacy, Compliance, Legal, vendors, and operational/functional teams to resolve dependencies and ensure compliant, scalable solutions.

Develop and maintain VoC dashboards and insights reporting to the management team across all international markets.


 Qualtrics and Reporting Platforms Administration


Serve as the senior administrator and product owner for Qualtrics XM Engage and XM Discover, including configuration standards, user access, roles, directories, workflows, dashboards, distributions, text analytics, and release/change governance.

Own platform health routines, usage monitoring, issue logs, enhancement backlog, vendor escalation, license utilization, and business continuity controls.

Design and govern survey and reporting solutions across relational and transactional programs, ensuring consistent triggers, questionnaires, embedded data, routing, notifications, close-the-loop workflows, and market comparability.

Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, technical feasibility, risk, data quality, and operating impact.

Create and maintain technical documentation, configuration inventories, process maps, data dictionaries, operating procedures, and audit evidence.

Own business configuration and governance decisions for the CXM platform ecosystem within approved enterprise policies and technical guardrails.


 Data Quality, Controls and Reporting


Own scheduled survey, platform, data, and reporting quality assurance, including, weekly, monthly QA before report distribution, documented evidence, issue tracking, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and prevention controls.

Collaborate with Business Intelligence and IT to maintain Customer Data Platform including new enhancements that might be required by the business.

Establish reconciliation and validation controls across source data, Qualtrics, Power BI, dashboards, recurring reports, and distributed outputs.

Develop and maintain role-based dashboards and executive reporting that provide reliable self-service visibility while reducing manual production and inconsistent interpretation.

Define service levels, quality thresholds, escalation paths, and performance measures for critical VoC data and platform processes.

Identify control gaps and lead corrective improvements to protect the accuracy, confidentiality, availability, and traceability of customer feedback data.

Escalate material data, platform, compliance, vendor, or delivery risks and recommend corrective action.


 Advanced Analytics and Customer Intelligence


Lead analysis of NPS, OSAT, CES, IRR, and other experience measures using statistically valid methods that distinguish directional findings from decision-grade evidence.

Develop and standardize driver-impact analysis, regression or key-driver models, segmentation, forecasting, experimentation, and impact estimation to identify the customer experience improvements that matter most.

Define analytical standards and determine whether results are sufficiently reliable for reporting, prioritization, or executive decision-making.

Build a consistent text analytics discipline using common taxonomies, topic modeling, sentiment, and root-cause analysis across open-text, chat, messaging, and call or conversation inputs.

Analyze complex datasets using SQL, Python, R, SAS/JMP, Excel, Power BI, or equivalent tools; automate repeatable data preparation, validation, analysis, and reporting where appropriate.

Present technical methods, limitations, findings, and recommendations in plain language for executives, markets, operations, and cross-functional teams.


 Projects, Initiatives and Stakeholder Management


Prioritize the CXM data and platform backlog based on strategic value, customer impact, risk, feasibility, capacity, and cross-market scalability.

Lead cross-functional workstreams and technical delivery through clear direction, operating routines, decision rights, milestones, risks, and accountability, including when contributors do not formally report to the role.

Participate in regular communications and meetings with the North American and IO Customer Experience teams, as well as branch level IO Stakeholders to ensure effective coordination between groups

Build networks with CXM leaders, market teams, IT, Data, Analytics, Digital, Operations, vendors, and Centers of Excellence to secure expertise and deliver shared objectives.

Coach and enable users on platform standards, data literacy, statistical interpretation, dashboard use, text analytics, and quality controls.

Communicate changes, address resistance, support adoption, and monitor whether new processes and capabilities deliver the intended results.

Provide concise updates on delivery, risks, decisions, platform health, data quality, adoption, and business impact to CXM leadership and stakeholders.

Qualifications

What makes You an ideal candidate?


Advanced proficiency with enterprise experience-management platforms, such as Qualtrics (XM Engage and XM Discover), Medallia, or equivalent solutions (Mandatory).
Advanced English (written and spoken)
Strong written and verbal presentation skills; ability to communicate effectively with senior management and cross-functional teams.
Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and JMP (Required).
Advanced proficiency in Excel and Power BI (Required).
Advanced knowledge of SAS and R (Preferred).
VBA programming skills (Preferred).


Additional Knowledge And Skills

Working effectively within an AI enabled environment:


Ability to use AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to support daily work
Skills in evaluating AI outputs for accuracy, compliance, and bias
Experience integrating AI into workflows to improve efficiency or insights
Familiarity with AI assisted research, summarization, and content generation
Understanding of responsible AI use, including ethics and data protection 


Work Experience & Education


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields
Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Finance, Statistics, Computer Science, or an MBA is preferred
Hands-on experience working with systems, databases, data warehouses, and data extraction/manipulation (Required)
Proven experience in quantitative analysis, variable transformation, statistical modeling, and Machine Learning (Required)
+2 years of Experience in reporting solutions, Analytics and/ or business intelligence
Solid assessment, quantitative, and problem-solving skills
Experience querying and analyzing complex data sets
Experience in Excel, SQL, PowerBi or other end-user reporting tool

Who We Are




Rothbard Group, based in Panama, is a boutique cross-border tax and corporate structuring firm that helps successful families and entrepreneurs protect and grow their wealth offshore. 




The firm is grounded in individual sovereignty and free-market economics. Our work uniquely combines the technical depth of traditional law firms and Big 4 practices with the modern client experience of offshore consultancies. 




Our lead tax attorney has built a large and engaged international audience through our popular YouTube channel, giving us a distinctive brand and a steady flow of high-quality inbound interest.







The Opportunity

This is a client-facing commercial sales role that will directly contribute to the success of the firm. You will be the first real conversation many high-net-worth individuals and entrepreneurs have with us. Your role is to quickly understand what sophisticated clients truly need, build genuine trust, and guide the right prospects to choose Rothbard as their partner. No technical advisory or tax preparation work is required.




Most sales roles in professional services ask you to sell someone else’s vision. Here you will be representing a firm whose principles you can actually stand behind — and whose clients care deeply about the same things you do.




You get the commercial upside of a sales role, the intellectual interest of complex cross-border work, and the lifestyle freedom that most corporate jobs simply do not offer.

description:
About the job

Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy


Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements


Asset Preparation & Coordination


Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework


Creative Intelligence & Testing


Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs


Tracking & Measurement


Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines


Team Flexibility


Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.


What We're Looking For


4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously


Nice to Have


Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

title: WANTED! The BEST Remote Junior Client Success Manager In The World
skills: A US-based growth consultancy for cash-pay medical practices: regenerative medicine, orthopedics, hormone optimization, stem cell therapy.
Our clients' patients pay out of pocket for treatments that cost thousands. Cheap leads do not cut it. We need people who can pay and actually show up.
We run Meta and Google ads into webinar and lead-gen funnels built in GoHighLevel.
We work in pods: small, lean teams that own a group of clients end to end, with a strategist and shared GoHighLevel, design and video support behind them.
Our team is spread across the US, Latin America, Pakistan, India, the Philippines, Egypt and Kenya, with leadership in Atlanta.
Monthly client churn is under 1%. You would inherit relationships that work, not a book of angry clients.
You own the relationship. The doctor emails you, Slacks you and gets on calls with you.

You turn requests into work. Every client ask becomes a ClickUp task the team can act on without a follow-up question, with the why attached. "Build a new landing page" is not a brief. "The heatmap shows people stop scrolling before the CTA, so the CTA moves above the fold" is. When it is something you can build, you build it.
You narrate the numbers. In two minutes, in plain English: what is working, what is not, and what is next.
You catch problems first. The client never discovers an issue we have not already told them about.
You spot the next win. Not a pitch. Arithmetic out loud with the client's own numbers until the next step is obvious.
Every client in your book got a response within one business hour of reaching out and a real answer or a timeline within a day.
Every client request became a ClickUp task with enough context that nobody had to come back to you to ask what it meant.
You ran the client calls yourself. The CEO was not on them.
You built or fixed automations, workflows or pages yourself instead of leaving them in someone else's queue.
Your pod's daily client updates went out accurate, because you read them before they shipped and corrected the one that was wrong.
No client surprised anyone with a problem, and no client cancelled without the risk being visible weeks earlier.
You brought at least one expansion case built on a client's real numbers, or explained why the timing was wrong.

You live in AI tools, and you want to learn the next one. You use Claude or similar every day, you can show us how, and you pick up new tools fast. This matters more to us than anything on your resume.
Fluent written and spoken English. Our clients are US doctors. You will write to them and speak with them every day.
You get your hands dirty. You are comfortable building things yourself, not just asking someone else to.

You own outcomes. You have handled client relationships and can tell us what you kept, what you lost and why. Haven't owned a client book yet? Tell us honestly, and tell us about the closest thing you've done.
You bring bad news early, with a plan. You do not wait to be asked.
You write clearly and fast. If your writing needs a second pass to be understood, this is the wrong seat.
You can hold a doctor's respect. Calm, direct, prepared, unbothered by pushback.
Healthcare or high-ticket cash-pay client experience
GoHighLevel, or a similar CRM and automation platform
Zapier, Make or other automation tools
Meta Ads Manager
Briefing builders, designers or media buyers, and getting the work back right the first time
Junior Client Success Managers start at $1,500 USD per month, plus a share of the pod's monthly bonus pool.
Raises follow responsibility, not tenure. More output and more responsibility earn more. Time served does not.
A 90-day review with the CEO, where we look at the results and set what comes next.
Find where you are strongest. Some people in this seat grow into leading a pod; others move toward strategy, ads or automation. Both are wins.
CSM to Strategist. This is a real step people here have been offered.
Earn more by carrying more. Cover more than one seat in your pod well and you earn more than one seat's share of the bonus.
Learn a niche most marketers never touch. Doctors as clients, four- and five-figure treatments. People who get good at this are rare, and they get paid like it.
Room to build, zero micromanagement. See a better way to run things? Say so and run it.
Reply to clients within 1 business hour, even if it is "got it, looking into it," with a real answer or a timeline within 24. Reply to internal Slack within 10 minutes.
Decisions live on the ClickUp task or in the client channel. Never in DMs.
Monday all-hands, 9:00 to 10:30 AM Eastern.
This is a fully remote position. If you do not have a quiet, productive place to work from home with reliable power and internet, this is not the right role for you.
Going quiet is the one thing that does not work here. Missed a deadline? Tell us. Stuck? Say "I hit a wall." Problems get named the same day, in the open.

No recipe, and the structure keeps moving. We are "building the plane while flying it," and pods, seats and clients change as we grow. The first 2 to 3 weeks are quiet. The people who thrive start digging before anyone asks.
The CEO is direct. Plain feedback, expected back. He loves being challenged and hates silence.

Doctors push back, and quality beats volume. Our clients are smart, busy and spending their own money, so you hold your ground with evidence. A cheap lead who cannot afford a $4,000 treatment is not a win. Compliance is non-negotiable: no guarantees, no definitive claims.
You are the last set of eyes. Errors that should have been caught in QA come out of the pod's bonus pool, just as retention and expansion grow it.
Give a shit. We act like this is our business, because in a way it is.
Better before bigger. Scale is earned by delivering undeniable value.
Sincere candor. Candor is kindness. We speak the hard truth early.
Move fast. Fix it. We ship fast, but we do not move on until it is fixed.
Prove it works. If it has not been tested, it is still just an opinion.
Unimpeachable character. We do not lie, hide or cut corners, especially when it is inconvenient.
Subject line: "I actually read the instructions."
A link to your resume as a PDF, named Lastname.Firstname.JuniorCSM.pdf
Your written answer: "Tell us about a client you lost. What did you see too late, and what would you do differently?"
A 2-minute Loom, camera on: why you want this role, and one real way you used AI in your work this week.
Send it all to: andrea+csmli@guidepostmarketing.com

Junior Client Success Manager · Guidepost

Full-time contractor · Fully remote · US Eastern hours · Reports to the CEO

Most account managers forward emails and read reports out loud on calls. We are not looking for that person.

Our clients are doctors who own cash-pay medical clinics. We are looking for the person they call first: the one who spots the problem before they do, tells them before they ask, and shows up with the fix already moving.

If that sounds like you, keep reading.




Who we are




Our website says it plainly: marketing agencies suck. Most of them earned that reputation. We built Guidepost to be the exception. We are operators who learned marketing, and every campaign, funnel and call ties back to one question: did the clinic make money?

A US-based growth consultancy for cash-pay medical practices: regenerative medicine, orthopedics, hormone optimization, stem cell therapy.
Our clients' patients pay out of pocket for treatments that cost thousands. Cheap leads do not cut it. We need people who can pay and actually show up.

You own the relationship. The doctor emails you, Slacks you and gets on calls with you.

"The heatmap shows people stop scrolling before the CTA, so the CTA moves above the fold" is. When it is something you can build, you build it.

You catch problems first. The client never discovers an issue we have not already told them about.
You spot the next win. Not a pitch. Arithmetic out loud with the client's own numbers until the next step is obvious.

This is not a messenger seat. You are client-facing first, but you also roll up your sleeves: from day one you build GoHighLevel automations, workflows and landing pages, and you use AI to do it fast. And if all you do on a call is read a report, you are not doing the job.




What a good month looks like




Every client in your book got a response within one business hour of reaching out and a real answer or a timeline within a day.
Every client request became a ClickUp task with enough context that nobody had to come back to you to ask what it meant.
You ran the client calls yourself. The CEO was not on them.
You built or fixed automations, workflows or pages yourself instead of leaving them in someone else's queue.
Your pod's daily client updates went out accurate, because you read them before they shipped and corrected the one that was wrong.
No client surprised anyone with a problem, and no client cancelled without the risk being visible weeks earlier.
You brought at least one expansion case built on a client's real numbers, or explained why the timing was wrong.




What we need from you




You live in AI tools, and you want to learn the next one. You use Claude or similar every day, you can show us how, and you pick up new tools fast. This matters more to us than anything on your resume.
Fluent written and spoken English. Our clients are US doctors. You will write to them and speak with them every day.
You get your hands dirty. You are comfortable building things yourself, not just asking someone else to.
You own outcomes. You have handled client relationships and can tell us what you kept, what you lost and why. Haven't owned a client book yet? Tell us honestly, and tell us about the closest thing you've done.
You bring bad news early, with a plan. You do not wait to be asked.
You write clearly and fast. If your writing needs a second pass to be understood, this is the wrong seat.
You can hold a doctor's respect. Calm, direct, prepared, unbothered by pushback.

You do not need to be a GoHighLevel expert on day one. We will teach you our ads and funnel setup, as long as you learn fast and are willing to build. Your core window is 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern, camera on for calls. Nobody counts your hours: we measure whether the standards are met.

Not required, but make sure to tell us if you have any of these:

Healthcare or high-ticket cash-pay client experience
GoHighLevel, or a similar CRM and automation platform
Zapier, Make or other automation tools
Meta Ads Manager
Briefing builders, designers or media buyers, and getting the work back right the first time




Pay and growth




Junior Client Success Managers start at $1,500 USD per month, plus a share of the pod's monthly bonus pool.
Raises follow responsibility, not tenure. More output and more responsibility earn more. Time served does not.
A 90-day review with the CEO, where we look at the results and set what comes next.
Find where you are strongest. Some people in this seat grow into leading a pod; others move toward strategy, ads or automation. Both are wins.
CSM to Strategist. This is a real step people here have been offered.
Earn more by carrying more. Cover more than one seat in your pod well and you earn more than one seat's share of the bonus.
Learn a niche most marketers never touch. Doctors as clients, four- and five-figure treatments. People who get good at this are rare, and they get paid like it.
Room to build, zero micromanagement. See a better way to run things? Say so and run it.

Terms: full-time independent contractor, paid semi-monthly in USD. 20 days of paid time off a year, including six US holidays, approved in advance. Fourteen-day notice, either party. Location flexible, Eastern hours fixed.




How we work




Reply to clients within 1 business hour, even if it is "got it, looking into it," with a real answer or a timeline within 24. Reply to internal Slack within 10 minutes.
Decisions live on the ClickUp task or in the client channel. Never in DMs.
Monday all-hands, 9:00 to 10:30 AM Eastern.




Skunks on the table




Every line is true. If one makes you want to close the tab, that is useful for both of us. If they make you lean in, you are probably who we are looking for.

This is a fully remote position. If you do not have a quiet, productive place to work from home with reliable power and internet, this is not the right role for you.
Going quiet is the one thing that does not work here. Missed a deadline? Tell us. Stuck? Say "I hit a wall." Problems get named the same day, in the open.
No recipe, and the structure keeps moving. We are "building the plane while flying it," and pods, seats and clients change as we grow. The first 2 to 3 weeks are quiet. The people who thrive start digging before anyone asks.
The CEO is direct. Plain feedback, expected back. He loves being challenged and hates silence.
Doctors push back, and quality beats volume. Our clients are smart, busy and spending their own money, so you hold your ground with evidence. A cheap lead who cannot afford a $4,000 treatment is not a win. Compliance is non-negotiable: no guarantees, no definitive claims.
You are the last set of eyes. Errors that should have been caught in QA come out of the pod's bonus pool, just as retention and expansion grow it.




Our values




Give a shit. We act like this is our business, because in a way it is.
Better before bigger. Scale is earned by delivering undeniable value.
Sincere candor. Candor is kindness. We speak the hard truth early.
Move fast. Fix it. We ship fast, but we do not move on until it is fixed.
Prove it works. If it has not been tested, it is still just an opinion.
Unimpeachable character. We do not lie, hide or cut corners, especially when it is inconvenient.




How to apply




Still reading? Good. That is the first test. Here is the second: follow these exactly.

Subject line: "I actually read the instructions."
A link to your resume as a PDF, named Lastname.Firstname.JuniorCSM.pdf
Your written answer: "Tell us about a client you lost. What did you see too late, and what would you do differently?"
A 2-minute Loom, camera on: why you want this role, and one real way you used AI in your work this week.
Send it all to: andrea+csmli@guidepostmarketing.com

We are genuinely excited to meet the person who reads this and thinks, "Finally." If you have a question before you apply, put it in your email and we will answer it. We cannot wait to see what you send.
